name: Mista

facts.text: Mista is a level-44 dead seeress (the cursed spirits' model) in Vanern Swamp (685,060/928,036) beside a dark seithkona initiate; no faction, aggressive.
facts.source: runtime/data/opendaoc.sqlite3.db, Mob and NpcTemplate tables (0.37b world data)

facts.text: 'An End to the Daggers' (Audun of Jordheim): 'Deal with the evil spread by Arica and Mista and their Skiethkona', then 'Give Arica's note to her brother Audun'. Arica is not spawned in the world data.
Mista as Ydenia's follower and Arica's teacher is Living Server lore.

story:
Mista went with Ydenia. When the seeress of the Circle walked out of Skona into Vanern Swamp to take the high seat the dark seithkona keep for her still, a handful of the Circle's women went with her, and Mista was the one who went furthest. She is dead now, a cursed spirit with a dark seithkona initiate at her side, and she still teaches.

Her last pupil was Arica, the sister of Audun of Jordheim, who drinks in the city's tavern and talks about the Red Daggers to anyone with a sword. Arica went into the swamp to bring Mista home and did not come back, and Audun sends the young after the evil the two of them spread among their seithkona, and asks them to bring back a note in his sister's hand. He reads it at his table and puts it inside his shirt, and nobody in the tavern has ever seen what it says. The Seithkona Circle says only that Arica went to save a teacher and found one instead.
legend: Mista is a level 44 cursed spirit in east Vanern with a dark seithkona initiate (44) beside her, for the Arica-and-Mista step of An End to the Daggers (Audun's version): deal with them and bring Arica's note to Audun. Arica isn't actually in the world data, only Mista. Pull the initiate with her and kill both; no faction on Mista herself.

aggro: The high seat is kept for her. Kneel, or lie down.
death: Tell her... the seat is still kept...

lairEntry: A dead seeress teaches in the reeds. Her pupil listens.
